faq.q: What is a titanium camber adjustment shim?
faq.a: A titanium camber adjustment shim is a precision-machined suspension component used in suspension geometry camber-adjusting shim stack. Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium camber adjustment shim?
faq.a: Titanium Camber Adjustment Shim is designed for suspension geometry camber-adjusting shim stack. The Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium camber adjustment shim manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Camber Adjustment Shim is manufactured using Hot forging. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium camber adjustment shim?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
